  <h2>Current Projects 🖥️</h2>
  <p><i>Homelab projects self-hosted on my home server, added here as they ship.</i></p>

  <h3>Home Control 🏠</h3>
  <p>A self-hosted smart-home dashboard for a wall- or counter-mounted iPad, built on Home Assistant in a VM on my home server.</p>
  <p>
    <b>Dashboard:</b> rooms, lighting, climate, pet devices, camera and energy usage at a glance<br/>
    <b>Fitness:</b> weight trend, days trained and workouts from Apple Health through a companion integration<br/>
    <b>Design:</b> custom dark-academia / gothic theme, iterated from mockups<br/>
    <b>Principles:</b> real data only (missing data shows as unavailable), local-first, home-network only with HTTPS<br/>
    <b>Stack:</b> Home Assistant OS, Unraid, Lovelace dashboards generated by a Node build script, YAML template sensors<br/>
    <b>Open source:</b> reported three bugs and a feature request to the Halthy integration
    (<a href="https://github.com/Mosher23/Halthy/issues/8">#8</a>, <a href="https://github.com/Mosher23/Halthy/issues/9">#9</a>, <a href="https://github.com/Mosher23/Halthy/issues/10">#10</a>, <a href="https://github.com/Mosher23/Halthy/issues/11">#11</a>).
  </p>
